Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a mental asylum doctor ordering a schizophrenic patient to take his pills, the patient refuses, and makes him take the pills to prove they are safe. The doctor obliges, but when he opens his eyes, the patient is gone, a figment of his imagination, revealing it was the doctor that was schizophrenic the whole time.  Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence.assistant
response:
INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

Dr. Smith, a middle-aged psychiatrist, stands in front of his patient, Jack, a disheveled young man with a wild look in his eye 🤪. Jack is sitting on the edge of his bed, his arms crossed and a defiant glint in his eye 💪.

DR. SMITH:
Jack, it's time for your medication. You know it's good for you 🤒.

JACK:
I don't want to take it! It's poison! 🚽

DR. SMITH:
(sighing) Jack, you're not listening to me. You need to take your medication to manage your symptoms 🤯.

JACK:
I won't take it! You can't make me! 🚫

DR. SMITH:
(frustrated) Fine. If you won't take it, then I'll take it for you myself 💊.

Jack looks up at Dr. Smith with a mixture of fear and defiance, but Dr. Smith just smiles and holds out the pill bottle 🤣.

DR. SMITH:
(taking the pill bottle) Ah, here we go. (pops a pill into his mouth) Ah, that's better 🤤.

As Dr. Smith swallows the pill, he looks up at Jack with a strange, far-off gaze 🌌.

DR. SMITH:
(whispering) You know, Jack... I think I'm starting to see things too... 🤯

Suddenly, the room begins to distort and blur, and Dr. Smith's eyes widen in shock 😱.

DR. SMITH:
(stunned) What... what's going on? 🤔

As the camera zooms out, we see that Dr. Smith is standing alone in the empty room, with no sign of Jack 🤷‍♂️. The door is closed, and the windows are barred, but Dr. Smith is standing in the middle of the room, looking around in confusion 🤯.

DR. SMITH:
(whispering) I... I think I'm the one who's been seeing things all along... 🤯

The camera zooms out further, and we see that Dr. Smith is standing in a completely different room, with no sign of the mental asylum 🏥. He's standing in a bright, sunny room, with a beautiful view of the ocean 🌊.

DR. SMITH:
(whispering) I'm not a doctor... I'm just a patient... 🤯

The camera zooms out even further, and we see that Dr. Smith is standing in a completely different world, with no sign of the mental asylum or the ocean 🌌. He's standing in a dark, twisted forest, with twisted trees and glowing eyes 👻.

DR. SMITH:
(whispering) I'm not a doctor... I'm not even a person... I'm just a figment of someone's imagination... 🤯

The camera zooms out even further, and we see that Dr. Smith is just a shadow, a faint outline of a person in a dark, twisted world 🌑.

DR. SMITH:
(whispering) I'm not real... I'm just a dream... 🤯

The screen fades to black, and the words "The End" appear on screen 🎬.
